name: Ippokratis Pantelidis
role_line: MSc AI student at the University of Amsterdam

about.bio_paragraph_1: I am an MSc Artificial Intelligence student at the University of Amsterdam with a passion for research. My thesis, in the VIS Lab, studies world models that act as action-conditioned verifiers in video games. Alongside it I work on two research projects: one examines the physical understanding of video foundation models, the other studies generative reranking in information retrieval.
about.bio_paragraph_2: Before this I studied Computer Science at the Athens University of Economics and Business, where I graduated first in my class with a 9.27/10. My bachelor thesis, supervised by Ion Androutsopoulos and John Pavlopoulos, was on diagnostic captioning: generating diagnostic text from medical images.

entries.description: Teaching assistant for Computer Vision 1 (MSc AI): weekly lab sessions and support on assignments and theory.

Object detection and classification models for large scale bridge inspection, and 3D reconstruction of bridges from multi-view imagery combining monocular depth estimation with multi-view triangulation.
Co-authored the AUEB NLP Group paper for ImageCLEFmedical Caption 2025 with the group's Biomedical Team (1st in Concept Detection and Explainability, 5th in Caption Prediction).

entries.organisation: Department of Computer and Systems Sciences, Stockholm University
entries.description: Containerised the top models of SemEval 2025 Task 9 (Food Hazard Detection) and deployed them to the EFRA DataHub; co-authored a multi-domain evaluation of Conformal In-Context Learning submitted to LREC 2026.
Forecasting of football time series, and a computer vision pipeline that compares Figma designs with implemented screens and explains the mismatches.
